messages.author: 7e9c6aec38eb7bcd
messages.subject: Character input via MatrixInput?
parts:
Hi all -

Quick question: Is it possible to input characters via MatrixInput? 

I've got a table of scenarios with a number of numeric parameters; the first column is the scenario name for scenario i, and the subsequent j columns are parameters for scenario i. 

Default scenarios load from a csv and have descriptive names; however, it looks like these names can't be changed and non-numeric characters can't be entered into the table. 

I'm guessing there's some table validation going on somewhere, but so far I haven't been able to crack it.  

You can access a stripped down version of what I'm working here:

https://gist.github.com/ajaypillarisetti/6583992

or using

runGist('6583992')

Thanks much -

Ajay

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Character input via MatrixInput?
parts: Sorry but this isn't supported by matrixInput. However, at least a couple of people in the community are working on bindings for HandsOnTable which should be more flexible. If you search the group you may even find a working binding (I'm on my phone or I would look for you).
